a.en: one; also 'each' as in $67 a barrel
a.es: un; una; por (a barrel: por barril)
a.zh: 一（不定冠詞）；每（$67 a barrel 每桶67美元）

about.en: close to a number; also on the subject of
about.ex: The trip takes about three hours.
about.zh: 大約；關於（talk about 談論）

acknowledged.ex: She acknowledged that the plan had problems.

across.es: en todo; a lo largo de
across.zh: 遍及；在整個…範圍（across the group/board）

administrative.en: about running and organising a business
administrative.ex: She does administrative work for a hospital.

after.en: following in time; after tax = once tax is paid

ahead.ex: We need to plan ahead for winter.
ahead.zh: 向前；未來（looking ahead 展望未來）

ai.en: computer systems that can do tasks needing human thinking
ai.ex: Many firms now use AI to answer emails.

airline.en: a company that flies planes carrying passengers
airline.ex: The airline added new routes to Spain.

airport.en: a place where planes take off and land
airport.ex: The airport was busy over the holidays.

airports.en: places where planes take off and land
airports.ex: Small airports often offer lower fees.

all.zh: 全部（all of this 這一切）

also.ex: She speaks French and also some German.

an.en: one; used before a vowel sound
an.zh: 一（不定冠詞，用於母音前）

and.en: used to join words or ideas

anticipates.ex: The council anticipates higher demand for buses.

example.en: The hotel anticipates a busy summer season.
example.zh: 這家飯店預期夏季會很忙碌。

note.usage: anticipate + 名詞/that 子句/V-ing；比 expect 正式，不接 to 不定詞。

noteEn.usage: Use 'anticipate' + noun or that-clause; more formal than 'expect'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El hotel prevé una temporada de verano con mucho movimiento.
noteEs.meaning: esperar o prever que algo ocurra.
noteEs.usage: anticipate + sustantivo/that; más formal que expect.

noteHi.exampleTr: होटल को व्यस्त गर्मियों के मौसम की उम्मीद है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी बात के होने की उम्मीद या अनुमान करना।
noteHi.usage: anticipate + संज्ञा/that वाक्य; expect से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: そのホテルは忙しい夏のシーズンを見込んでいる。
noteJa.meaning: 何かが起こると予想する。
noteJa.usage: anticipate + 名詞/that節；expect よりフォーマル。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 호텔은 바쁜 여름 시즌을 예상하고 있다.

application.en: the use of something for a practical purpose
application.ex: The application of new technology cut waiting times.

approximately.ex: The bridge is approximately two kilometres long.

april.en: the fourth month of the year

around.ex: Around 200 people came to the meeting.

artificial.ex: The garden has an artificial lake.
artificial.zh: 人工的（artificial intelligence 人工智慧）

as.es: ya que; mientras; (twice as much: el doble)
as.zh: 因為；隨著；（twice as much 兩倍多；even as 即使在…的同時）

ask.ex: You can ask the hotel for a later checkout.

associated.ex: Smoking is associated with many health problems.
associated.zh: 有關聯的（associated with 與…相關）

at.en: used to show a price or rate

ate.en: ate into: slowly reduced an amount
ate.ex: Rising rents ate into their savings.
ate.zh: 侵蝕（ate into 吃掉、削減）

attributable.ex: Most delays were attributable to bad weather.

example.en: Much of the rise in prices is attributable to higher energy costs.
example.zh: 物價上漲有很大一部分可歸因於能源成本上升。

note.usage: 固定搭配 attributable to + 名詞；常用 directly/largely/primarily attributable to，屬正式寫作用語。

noteEn.usage: Use 'attributable to' + noun; common in formal reports.

noteEs.exampleTr: Gran parte de la subida de precios es atribuible a los mayores costes de energía.
noteEs.meaning: que se debe a algo; atribuible.
noteEs.usage: Se usa attributable to + sustantivo; directly/largely attributable to en textos formales.

noteHi.exampleTr: क़ीमतों में बढ़ोतरी का बड़ा हिस्सा ऊँची ऊर्जा लागत के कारण है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी कारण से उत्पन्न; के कारण।
noteHi.usage: attributable to + संज्ञा; directly/largely attributable to औपचारिक लेखन में आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 物価上昇の多くはエネルギーコストの上昇に起因する。
noteJa.usage: attributable to + 名詞 の形。directly/largely attributable to はフォーマルな文で多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 물가 상승의 상당 부분은 에너지 비용 상승에 기인한다.
noteKo.usage: attributable to + 명사 형태; directly/largely attributable to는 격식체에서 흔하다.

average.en: typical; found by adding and dividing
average.ex: The average price of a coffee is now €4.

back-office.en: about office jobs that do not deal with customers
back-office.ex: The bank moved its back-office jobs abroad.
back-office.ja: バックオフィスの；事務部門の

balloon.en: to increase quickly to a large amount
balloon.ex: Her phone bill ballooned while she was abroad.

barrel.en: a unit for measuring oil, about 159 litres
barrel.ex: Oil prices rose above $90 a barrel.

barring.hi: को छोड़कर; जब तक … न हो
barring.zh: 除非；除了…之外（barring 若無…）

become.ex: Train tickets have become more expensive.

beginning.ex: The course runs for a term beginning in May.
beginning.zh: 開始於（the year beginning in April 自四月起的年度）

big.ex: It is a big company with many shops.

biggest.ex: This is the biggest bank in the country.

bill.en: the total amount of money you must pay
bill.ex: Our heating bill doubled last winter.
bill.zh: 帳單；費用（fuel bill 燃油費用）

board.en: across the board: in every area or part
board.es: (across the board) en todos los ámbitos
board.ex: The firm raised wages across the board.
board.hi: बोर्ड; (across the board) हर क्षेत्र में
board.zh: 全面（across the board 全面地、各方面）

booked.ex: The shop booked record sales in December.

boss.en: the person in charge of a company
boss.ex: The boss thanked everyone for their hard work.

bought.ex: We bought our train tickets a month early.
bought.zh: 買了（bought early 提早購買）

bracing.en: preparing for something bad to happen
bracing.ex: Farmers are bracing for another dry summer.
bracing.hi: तैयार हो रहा है (मुश्किल के लिए)
bracing.ja: 備えている；身構えている
bracing.zh: 做好準備（應付壞事）（brace for）

busier.ex: The station is busier on Fridays.

by.en: used to show the amount of change

cabin.en: the area where passengers sit in a plane
cabin.ex: The cabin was full on the morning flight.

carried.en: transported people from one place to another
carried.ex: The ferry carried 500 passengers a day.

carrier.en: a company that carries passengers or goods
carrier.ex: The national carrier cancelled several flights.

cautioned.ex: Doctors cautioned that the virus could return.
cautioned.ja: 警告した；注意を促した

charges.en: amounts of money asked for a service
charges.ex: The bank lowered its charges for small firms.

chief.ex: She is the chief engineer on the project.
chief.ja: 最高の；（chief executive）最高経営責任者
chief.zh: 首席的；最高的（chief executive 執行長）

climb.ex: House prices continued to climb this year.

commencing.ex: Work on the road is commencing next week.

company.en: a business that sells goods or services
company.ex: The company hired fifty new staff.

compared.en: compared with: when you look at the difference
compared.ex: Sales rose 5% compared with last year.

compensate.en: to make up for a loss or problem
compensate.ex: Higher wages did not compensate for rising rents.

comprehensive.ex: The school carried out a comprehensive review of safety.

example.en: The council published a comprehensive plan for public transport.
example.zh: 市議會發布了一份全面的大眾運輸計畫。

note.meaning: 全面的；綜合的；涵蓋所有方面的。
note.usage: 常修飾 review, plan, study, report；IELTS 中可取代 complete/full 使文字更正式。

noteEn.meaning: including all or nearly all parts.

noteEs.exampleTr: El ayuntamiento publicó un plan integral de transporte público.
noteEs.meaning: que incluye todos los aspectos; integral.
noteEs.usage: Acompaña a review, plan, study; más formal que complete.

noteHi.exampleTr: परिषद ने सार्वजनिक परिवहन के लिए एक व्यापक योजना प्रकाशित की।
noteHi.meaning: सभी पहलुओं को शामिल करने वाला; व्यापक।
noteHi.usage: review, plan, study के साथ आम; complete से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 市議会は公共交通の包括的な計画を発表した。
noteJa.meaning: すべての面を含む；包括的な。
noteJa.usage: review, plan, study などを修飾；complete より硬い表現。

noteKo.exampleTr: 시의회는 대중교통에 관한 포괄적인 계획을 발표했다.
noteKo.usage: review, plan, study 등을 수식하며 complete보다 격식 있다.

concessions.en: things you agree to give to end a disagreement
concessions.ex: The union won several concessions from management.

example.en: The airline won price concessions from several airports.
example.zh: 這家航空公司從幾座機場爭取到價格上的讓步。

note.meaning: 讓步；（談判中爭取到的）優惠條件。
note.usage: make/win/wring concessions；concessions from/out of sb；常用複數，指談判中對方讓出的好處。

noteEn.meaning: things given up to reach an agreement.

noteEs.exampleTr: La aerolínea consiguió concesiones de precio de varios aeropuertos.
noteEs.meaning: algo que se cede en una negociación; concesión.
noteEs.usage: make/win concessions; concessions from alguien; suele ir en plural.

noteHi.exampleTr: एयरलाइन ने कई हवाई अड्डों से क़ीमत में रियायतें हासिल कीं।
noteHi.meaning: बातचीत में दूसरा पक्ष जो छूट या रियायत देता है।
noteHi.usage: make/win concessions; concessions from किसी से; अक्सर बहुवचन।

noteJa.exampleTr: その航空会社はいくつかの空港から料金面の譲歩を勝ち取った。
noteJa.meaning: 交渉で相手が譲ったもの；譲歩。
noteJa.usage: make/win concessions、concessions from 人 の形；複数形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 항공사는 여러 공항으로부터 요금 양보를 얻어냈다.
noteKo.usage: make/win concessions, concessions from 사람 형태; 주로 복수형.

conducting.ex: The council is conducting a survey of residents.
conducting.hi: संचालित कर रहा है; कर रहा है

conflict.ex: The conflict has forced many families to leave.

consequently.ex: The road was closed; consequently, buses were late.

contingent.ex: The deal is contingent on government approval.

example.en: The new bridge is contingent on government funding.
example.zh: 新橋的興建取決於政府的資金。

note.usage: 固定用 contingent on/upon + 名詞；是正式用語，常見於合約、計畫與前景描述。

noteEs.exampleTr: El nuevo puente depende de la financiación del Gobierno.
noteEs.meaning: que depende de otra cosa; condicionado.
noteEs.usage: Se usa contingent on/upon + sustantivo; registro formal.

noteHi.exampleTr: नया पुल सरकारी धन पर निर्भर है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी और बात पर निर्भर; शर्त पर आधारित।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい橋の建設は政府の資金次第だ。
noteJa.usage: contingent on/upon + 名詞 の形。フォーマルな表現。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 다리 건설은 정부 자금에 달려 있다.

corresponding.ex: Sales beat the corresponding month last year.
corresponding.zh: 相應的；同期的（corresponding period 同期）

cost.en: the money needed to buy or do something
cost.ex: The cost of repairs was higher than expected.
cost.zh: 成本；費用（the rest cost 其餘花費）

costs.en: the money a business spends to operate
costs.ex: The firm cut costs by closing two shops.

could.en: used to say something is possible

cover.en: to be enough money to pay for something
cover.ex: The grant will not cover all the costs.

crew.en: the people who work on a plane
crew.ex: The crew helped an ill passenger.
crew.zh: 機組人員（cabin crew 空服員）

crewing.en: the number of staff placed on flights
crewing.ex: Lower crewing on night trains worried unions.

cut.ex: The shop plans to cut its opening hours.

decline.en: a fall in amount or level
decline.ex: There was a sharp decline in car sales.

declined.ex: Visitor numbers declined after the storm.

demand.en: how much people want to buy something
demand.ex: Demand for electric cars keeps growing.

deploying.en: putting something into use for a purpose
deploying.ex: The city is deploying robots to clean streets.

doubled.ex: The price of eggs doubled in a year.

down.ex: Sales were down 5% on last year.
down.ja: 下がって；（down from）〜から減少

drop.en: a fall in amount or level
drop.ex: There was a big drop in visitor numbers.

earlier.es: antes (a year earlier: un año antes)
earlier.ex: Sales were higher two years earlier.
earlier.zh: 更早；之前（a year earlier 一年前）

early.en: before the usual or expected time
early.ex: Book early to get the best seats.

earned.en: got money as profit or pay
earned.ex: The bakery earned more at Christmas.

east.en: part of the name Middle East
east.zh: 東方（the Middle East 中東）

edging.en: edging up: rising slowly by a small amount
edging.zh: 緩慢地移動；小幅上升（edging up）

effectively.ex: The new rule effectively bans cars from the centre.

emphasised.en: said something strongly to show it is important
emphasised.ex: The teacher emphasised the need to practise.

employees.en: people who work for a company
employees.ex: The company has 300 employees in Dublin.

encompassing.ex: The plan encompasses housing, transport and health.

end.en: the last part of a period
end.ex: The offer ends at the end of the month.
end.zh: 末；結束（the end of September 九月底）

ending.ex: Profits rose in the year ending June.
ending.zh: 截至；結束於（six months ending September 30th）

estimated.ex: An estimated 5,000 people joined the march.

even.en: used to show something is surprising
even.ex: Even small savings can help families.
even.zh: 即使；甚至（even as 即使在…同時）

ever.ex: The park is busier than ever this summer.
ever.zh: 曾經；以往任何時候（busier than ever 前所未有地忙）

executive.en: a senior manager in a company
executive.ex: The executive announced job cuts on Monday.
executive.zh: 主管；高階經理人（chief executive 執行長）

expects.ex: The shop expects busy weekends in December.

expenditure.ex: Government expenditure on schools rose last year.

example.en: Expenditure on health rose sharply last year.
example.zh: 去年醫療支出急劇增加。

note.usage: 正式用語，常用 expenditure on + 名詞；public/government/capital expenditure；多為不可數。

noteEs.exampleTr: El gasto en sanidad aumentó mucho el año pasado.
noteEs.usage: Término formal: expenditure on + sustantivo, public expenditure.

noteHi.exampleTr: पिछले साल स्वास्थ्य पर व्यय तेज़ी से बढ़ा।
noteHi.meaning: ख़र्च की गई कुल राशि; व्यय।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक शब्द; expenditure on + संज्ञा, public expenditure आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 昨年、医療への支出が急増した。
noteJa.meaning: 使ったお金の総額；支出。
noteJa.usage: フォーマルな語。expenditure on + 名詞、public expenditure の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: 격식체; expenditure on + 명사, public expenditure가 흔하다.

expensive.ex: Eating out has become very expensive.

face.en: to have to deal with something difficult
face.ex: Many farmers face higher costs this year.

fare.en: the money paid for a journey
fare.ex: The bus fare went up by 20 cents.

fares.ex: Train fares will rise in January.

fell.ex: The price of milk fell last month.

financial.ex: The club is in financial trouble.
financial.zh: 財務的；財政的（financial year 財政年度）

firmer.ex: Firmer oil prices helped energy shares.

fixed.ex: They pay a fixed rate on their loan.

flew.ex: We flew to Rome for the weekend.
flew.zh: 搭飛機（flew with 搭乘…的班機）

flights.ex: Many flights were delayed by fog.

for.en: used to show purpose or a period
for.zh: 為了；持續（for a time 一段時間）；（six months）的

freezes.en: times when pay or prices are not allowed to rise
freezes.ex: Pay freezes are common when firms struggle.
freezes.zh: 凍結（pay freezes 薪資凍結）

from.en: starting at a time, place or amount

frozen.en: kept at the same level and not raised
frozen.ex: Rents were frozen for two years.
frozen.zh: 被凍結（pay frozen 薪資凍結）

fuel.en: oil-based liquid that powers planes and cars
fuel.ex: The van uses less fuel than the old one.

functions.en: jobs or departments in an organisation
functions.ex: The firm moved its finance functions online.

furthermore.en: in addition to what was just said
furthermore.ex: The flat is cheap; furthermore, it is near work.

gap.ex: Cuts were made to close the budget gap.
gap.zh: 缺口；差額（plug the gap 填補缺口）

get.ex: Workers will get a bonus in December.

go.ex: Bus fares will go up next month.

greater.ex: Parents want greater choice of schools.
greater.ja: より大きな；より多くの

group.en: a company made up of several businesses
group.ex: The hotel group owns forty hotels.

had.en: used to form the past perfect
had.zh: 已經（過去完成式助動詞）

half-year.ex: The bank's half-year results beat forecasts.

has.en: used to form the present perfect
has.zh: 已經（現在完成式助動詞）；有

have.en: used to say something is done to you
have.es: tener (que); (have pay frozen) ver su sueldo congelado
have.zh: 使…被（have their pay frozen 薪資被凍結）

hedged.en: fixed a price in advance to avoid price risk
hedged.ex: The airline hedged most of next year's fuel.

example.en: The company hedged its dollar costs for the next year.
example.zh: 這家公司為明年的美元成本做了避險。

note.meaning: （金融）避險；預先鎖定價格以降低價格波動的風險。
note.usage: hedge + 物（hedge fuel/currency）或 hedge against + 風險；航空公司常說 hedged X% of its fuel。

noteEn.meaning: fixed a price early to protect against price changes.
noteEn.usage: Use 'hedge fuel' or 'hedge against a risk'.

noteEs.exampleTr: La empresa cubrió sus costes en dólares para el próximo año.
noteEs.meaning: (finanzas) fijar un precio de antemano para reducir el riesgo.
noteEs.usage: Se usa hedge + objeto o hedge against + riesgo; las aerolíneas dicen hedged X% of fuel.

noteHi.exampleTr: कंपनी ने अगले साल की अपनी डॉलर लागत को हेज कर लिया।
noteHi.meaning: (वित्त) पहले से क़ीमत तय कर जोखिम से बचाव करना।
noteHi.usage: hedge + वस्तु या hedge against + जोखिम; एयरलाइन hedged X% of its fuel कहती हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: その会社は来年のドル建てコストをヘッジした。
noteJa.meaning: （金融）価格を事前に固定してリスクを避ける。
noteJa.usage: hedge + 物、または hedge against + リスク。航空会社は hedged X% of its fuel と言う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 회사는 내년 달러 비용을 헤지했다.
noteKo.usage: hedge + 대상 또는 hedge against + 위험; 항공사는 hedged X% of its fuel이라고 한다.

held.ex: Sales held up well despite the rain.
held.zh: 維持；保持穩定（held up 表現堅挺）

high.ex: Rents remain high in the city centre.

higher.ex: Higher prices mean people buy less.

however.en: used to add a contrasting point
however.ex: The hotel was nice. However, it was expensive.

implemented.en: put a plan or decision into action
implemented.ex: The new timetable will be implemented in May.

in.en: inside a place, time or thing

include.en: to have as part of a group

income.ex: Tourism is the town's main source of income.

increase.en: a rise in amount or level
increase.ex: There was an increase in train delays.

increased.ex: Costs increased after the new tax.
increased.zh: 增加；增加的（increased application 更多的應用）

intelligence.en: the ability to learn and think
intelligence.ex: The app uses artificial intelligence to translate speech.
intelligence.zh: 智慧（artificial intelligence 人工智慧）

into.en: continuing to a later time; also entering
into.zh: 到…（well into 2027 一直到2027年很久）；（ate into 侵蝕）

jet.en: a fast plane; jet fuel = fuel for planes
jet.ex: The jet landed safely in the storm.
jet.ja: ジェット（jet fuel ジェット燃料）
jet.zh: 噴射機（jet fuel 航空燃油）

just.es: justo; poco (just over: algo más de)
just.ja: ちょうど；（just over）〜を少し超える
just.zh: 剛好；略（just over 略多於）

largest.ex: It is the largest hospital in the region.

last.ex: We went to Spain last summer.
last.zh: 上一個的（last year 去年）

levels.ex: Staffing levels in hospitals are too low.
levels.zh: 水準；程度（crewing levels 人員配置數量）

linked.ex: The delays were linked to a computer fault.

locked.en: locked in: fixed a price so it cannot change
locked.ex: They locked in a low mortgage rate.
locked.zh: 鎖定（locked in 預先鎖定價格）

looking.en: looking ahead: thinking about the future
looking.es: mirando (looking ahead: de cara al futuro)
looking.ex: Looking ahead, the school plans to grow.
looking.zh: 展望（looking ahead 展望未來）

low-fares.ex: A low-fares airline opened a base in Cork.

lower.en: less high in amount or level

made.ex: The café made a small profit last year.

main.ex: The main reason was the bad weather.

margins.en: the difference between costs and selling price
margins.ex: Shops face thin margins after rent rises.

may.en: used to say something is possible

middle.en: part of the name Middle East

money.en: what you use to buy things
money.ex: They saved money by cooking at home.

paragraphs: Ryanair is a big Irish airline. It made less money this year. Its profit for six months fell by 15%. It made €2.15 billion, down from €2.54 billion.
More people flew with Ryanair. It carried 125.8 million passengers, up 6%. But tickets were cheaper. The average fare fell by 4%.
The big problem is fuel. Fuel is very expensive because of a war in the Middle East. Ryanair thinks its fuel bill will go up by about €2 billion next year.
The boss, Michael O'Leary, wants to cut costs. Some workers may not get a pay rise. The airline will also use more AI in its offices. It will also ask airports for lower prices.
sentZh: 瑞安航空是一家愛爾蘭的大型航空公司。
它今年賺的錢變少了。
它六個月的獲利下跌了15%。
它賺了21.5億歐元，比之前的25.4億歐元少。
更多人搭乘瑞安航空。
它載了1億2580萬名乘客，增加了6%。
但機票變便宜了。
平均票價下跌了4%。
最大的問題是燃油。
因為中東的戰爭，燃油非常昂貴。
瑞安航空認為，明年它的燃油費用將增加約20億歐元。
老闆麥可・歐萊利想要削減成本。
有些員工可能不會加薪。
這家航空公司也會在辦公室使用更多人工智慧。
它也會要求機場降低收費。

paragraphs: Ryanair, Ireland's biggest airline, has said its profit fell by 15% in the six months to the end of September. It made €2.15 billion after tax, compared with €2.54 billion a year earlier.

The airline was busier than ever. It carried 125.8 million passengers, 6% more than last year, and its income rose by 3% to just over €10 billion. However, average ticket prices fell by 4%, and costs went up.

The main reason is the price of fuel. Because of the war in the Middle East, jet fuel has become much more expensive. Ryanair bought most of its fuel early at a fixed price, but the rest cost about twice as much as before.
The company expects its fuel bill to rise by about €2 billion in the year from April 2027. Chief executive Michael O'Leary said higher fares next year probably will not cover all of this.

To save money, Ryanair will talk to airports about lower charges, use fewer cabin crew on some flights and use more artificial intelligence in office work. Some staff may also have their pay frozen for a time.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭最大的航空公司瑞安航空表示，截至九月底的六個月內，其獲利下跌了15%。
它的稅後獲利為21.5億歐元，而前一年同期為25.4億歐元。
這家航空公司比以往任何時候都忙碌。
它載運了1億2580萬名乘客，比去年多6%，收入也增加3%，達到略高於100億歐元。
不過，平均機票價格下跌了4%，成本則上升了。
主要原因是燃油價格。
由於中東戰爭，航空燃油變得貴很多。
瑞安航空提早以固定價格買下了大部分燃油，但其餘燃油的價格大約是以前的兩倍。
公司預計，從2027年4月起的一年內，燃油費用將增加約20億歐元。
執行長麥可・歐萊利表示，明年較高的票價大概無法完全抵銷這部分。
為了省錢，瑞安航空將與機場商談降低收費，在部分航班上減少空服員人數，並在辦公室工作中更多使用人工智慧。
部分員工的薪資也可能被凍結一段時間。

paragraphs: Ryanair has reported a 15% drop in half-year profit, as soaring fuel prices linked to the conflict in the Middle East pushed up its costs. The airline earned €2.15 billion after tax in the six months to September 30th, down from €2.54 billion in the same period last year.
Passenger numbers grew by 6% to 125.8 million, and revenue rose 3% to €10.08 billion. However, average fares fell by 4%, while overall costs increased by around 10%.

Ryanair had hedged 80% of its fuel needs at $67 a barrel, but the cost of the remaining unhedged fuel roughly doubled. Looking ahead, the airline expects its fuel bill to climb by an estimated €2 billion in the financial year beginning in April 2027.

Group chief executive Michael O'Leary warned that higher fares were unlikely to fully offset this increase. Unless the Middle East conflict is resolved quickly, he said, jet fuel prices would stay high well into 2027.

The company is now reviewing costs across the group. Options include tougher negotiations with airports, lower crewing levels, greater use of AI in back-office work and possible temporary pay freezes for staff.
sentZh: 瑞安航空公布半年獲利下跌15%，因為與中東衝突相關的燃油價格飆升，推高了公司成本。
這家航空公司在截至9月30日的六個月內稅後賺得21.5億歐元，低於去年同期的25.4億歐元。
乘客人數成長6%，達到1億2580萬人次，營收增加3%，達到100.8億歐元。
然而，平均票價下跌了4%，而整體成本則上升了約10%。
瑞安航空已以每桶67美元的價格，為80%的燃油需求做了避險，但其餘未避險燃油的成本大約翻了一倍。
展望未來，這家航空公司預計，在2027年4月開始的財政年度中，燃油費用將增加估計20億歐元。
集團執行長麥可・歐萊利警告說，較高的票價不太可能完全抵銷這項增加。
他說，除非中東衝突迅速解決，否則航空燃油價格到2027年仍會維持在高檔很長一段時間。
公司目前正在檢討整個集團的成本。
可行方案包括與機場進行更強硬的談判、降低機組人員配置、在後勤工作中更多使用人工智慧，以及可能暫時凍結員工薪資。

paragraphs: Ryanair has posted a 15% slide in half-year profit, as a spike in fuel prices stemming from the Middle East conflict ate into its margins. Europe's largest low-fares carrier booked €2.15 billion after tax in the six months to September 30th, against €2.54 billion a year earlier.

Traffic held up robustly, with passenger numbers climbing 6% to 125.8 million and revenue edging up 3% to €10.08 billion. Yet average fares slipped 4%, even as overall costs swelled by roughly a tenth.

Although the airline had locked in 80% of its fuel requirements at $67 a barrel, the price of its unhedged fuel effectively doubled. It is now bracing for its fuel bill to balloon by an estimated €2 billion in the financial year commencing in April 2027.

Group chief executive Michael O'Leary cautioned that firmer fares would be unlikely to plug that gap entirely, and that, barring a swift resolution in the Middle East, jet fuel would remain stubbornly expensive well into 2027.

Consequently, the carrier is scrutinising costs across the board, from wringing concessions out of airports and trimming crewing ratios to deploying AI in back-office functions. Staff could also face temporary pay freezes.
sentZh: 瑞安航空公布半年獲利下滑15%，因為中東衝突引發的燃油價格飆漲侵蝕了其利潤率。
這家歐洲最大的低票價航空公司在截至9月30日的六個月內入帳稅後21.5億歐元，而前一年同期為25.4億歐元。
客運量表現強勁，乘客人數攀升6%至1億2580萬人次，營收小幅成長3%至100.8億歐元。
然而，即使整體成本膨脹了大約一成，平均票價仍滑落4%。
雖然這家航空公司已以每桶67美元鎖定了80%的燃油需求，但其未避險燃油的價格實際上翻了一倍。
它現在正做好準備，預期在2027年4月開始的財政年度，燃油費用將暴增估計20億歐元。
集團執行長麥可・歐萊利提醒說，較堅挺的票價不太可能完全填補這個缺口；而且，除非中東局勢迅速得到解決，否則航空燃油到2027年仍將長時間居高不下。
因此，這家航空公司正在全面仔細檢視成本，從向機場爭取讓步、削減機組人員配置比例，到在後勤部門運用人工智慧。
員工也可能面臨暫時的薪資凍結。

paragraphs: Ryanair has reported a 15% decline in its half-year profit, primarily attributable to a substantial increase in fuel prices associated with the conflict in the Middle East. The airline recorded a profit after tax of €2.15 billion for the six months ending September 30th, compared with €2.54 billion in the corresponding period of the previous year.

Demand nevertheless remained resilient. Passenger numbers increased by 6% to 125.8 million, and revenue rose by 3% to €10.08 billion. Average fares, however, declined by 4%, whereas total operating costs increased by approximately 10%.

Although the company had hedged 80% of its fuel requirements at $67 per barrel, the cost of its unhedged fuel approximately doubled. Furthermore, it anticipates that its fuel expenditure will rise by an estimated €2 billion in the financial year commencing in April 2027.

Group chief executive Michael O'Leary acknowledged that higher fares were unlikely to compensate fully for this increase. He emphasised that the outlook for fuel prices was contingent upon a rapid resolution of the Middle East conflict.

Consequently, the airline is conducting a comprehensive review of its expenditure, encompassing airport negotiations, reduced crewing ratios and the increased application of artificial intelligence in administrative functions. Temporary pay freezes for employees may also be implemented.
